80539.title: Panjaa
80539.overview: Jai, an orphan, falls into bad company after Bhagwan, a gangster, gives him shelter and hope to live. However, Jai and Munna, Bhagwan's son, fight with each other after Munna kills an innocent woman.

1000155.title: Only Rebels Win
1000155.overview: Suzanne and Osmane meet in crisis-ridden Beirut. Osmane is a young Sudanese man without papers, searching for a better future; Suzanne is a widow with Palestinian roots more than twice his age. Against all odds, they fall in love.

1084187.title: Pretty Lethal
1084187.overview: A troupe of ballerinas find themselves fighting for survival as they attempt to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.

1125403.title: In the Shadows
1125403.overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

1195803.title: Wicker
1195803.overview: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

1205851.title: Gamer Girls
1205851.overview: Youth is always full of confusion, electronic gaming may be a way to achieve hero's dream. This is a story of six passionate girls fighting hard in the gaming world, hoping to break the social stereotype. Yet this is more difficult than it seems, with all the unknown challenges ahead.

1212763.title: Evil Dead Burn
1212763.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

1232667.title: Miss You, Love You
1232667.overview: A blunt, grieving widow is forced to plan her husband’s funeral with a total stranger: her estranged gay son’s gay assistant. As they fumble through grief and their strange, darkly funny circumstances, buried secrets and long-held resentments surface, but their partnership becomes an unlikely conduit for connection, laughter, and healing for this mother and her unexpected surrogate son.

1233883.title: Epitaph
1233883.overview: Newlywed Anna and her husband relocate to Alaska, but their blissful life takes a dark turn when a car crash causes Anna to develop selective amnesia. The incident triggers agoraphobia and haunting flashbacks.

1234139.title: Jailer 2
1234139.overview: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

1286491.title: Jimpa
1286491.overview: Hannah and her non-binary teenager Frances visit her gay grandfather Jimpa in Amsterdam. Frances expresses a desire to stay with their grandfather for a year, challenging Hannah's parenting beliefs and forcing her to confront past issues.

1309083.title: Dolly
1309083.overview: Young Macy is abducted by a deranged, monstrous figure who wants to raise her as its child.

1321179.title: The King's Warden
1321179.overview: In a remote mountain village of 15th-century Joseon, humble headman Heung-do hears a rumor that any village hosting an exiled nobleman will be blessed with abundance and fortune. Hoping to bring prosperity to his impoverished community, he eagerly submits a petition to host one—unaware that his guest is none other than the fallen monarch, deposed boy-king Danjong.
1321179.trailerName: The King's Warden | Trailer ENG SUB | In AU & NZ Cinemas from Feb 19

1327835.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
1327835.overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

1369243.title: (Des)controle
1369243.overview: At a turbulent time in her life and career, an overwhelmed writer seeking relief returns to drinking after 15 years of sobriety, but goes from a simple glass of wine to total loss of control.

1371035.title: Manok
1371035.overview: Manok, the owner of a South Korean lesbian bar, trades rainbow lights for small-town politics when she moves back home and challenges her ex-husband for mayor.

1372443.title: Mr. Irrelevant
1372443.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

1391899.title: Traction Park Massacre
1391899.overview: A group of teens set out to the ruins of an abandoned amusement park that burned down fifteen years earlier. The incident is known to have killed two brothers who were trapped inside, but the brothers survived and now haunt the park.

1400731.title: André Is an Idiot
1400731.overview: André, a brilliant idiot, is dying because he didn’t get a colonoscopy. His sobering diagnosis, complete irreverence, and insatiable curiosity, send him on an unexpected journey learning how to die happily and ridiculously without losing his sense of humor.

1400923.title: You, Always
1400923.overview: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

1403355.title: Down the Long River
1403355.overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

1410587.title: The Brightest Sun
1410587.overview: When a private detective is murdered, a former colleague and a trainee detective are sent to investigate. Along the way, they uncover a tragic truth that triggers memories from their own haunted pasts.

1413403.title: Playing War
1413403.overview: In war, people's lives are at stake; in this world, people are the object of a child's whim, which can lead many to break their worldview... literally.

1421979.title: The Python Hunt
1421979.overview: Every year, the Florida government invites the general public to compete in an invasive python removal contest in the Everglades. For ten nights, an eclectic group of hunters confront the dangerous terrain, nocturnal creatures and their own desires.

1433051.title: Adrenal
1433051.overview: CHAI Ya-hui returned to Taiwan after getting married in Japan. Since her husband committed suicide, she lived alone with her daughter Xiao-xiao. They were chased by gangsters. One day, Xiao-xiao and her classmate Ya-hoo were kidnapped, Ya-hui asked the police for help but was troubled, so she decided to save her daughter herself. The kidnappers use high-tech methods to torture her and Xiao-xiao, and unravel mysteries related to past dismemberments, organ trafficking, and historical trauma. As clues are intertwined, Ya-hui discovers the key to solving the case, and finally reveals the truth behind the obsession and trauma, and brings an unexpected ending.

1451867.title: Ghost Elephants
1451867.overview: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

1453659.title: Red Beast
1453659.overview: Eetu Salin, a fiery working-class agitator and one of the founders of the Finnish Social Democratic Party, struggles not only with his childhood traumas and alcoholism but also against young radical socialists within the party who are vying for power. Eetu, who advocates for class struggle through peaceful means, joins forces with his friends Väinö Tanner and Yrjö Mäkelin to try to prevent the Finnish working class from being drawn into a violent revolution.

1460443.title: A Beat to Rest
1460443.overview: Late into his career, an elderly drummer comes to terms with getting older.
1460443.trailerName: WORLD PREMIERE: A Beat to Rest by Dan Silver

1461275.title: Plastic Surgery
1461275.overview: A doctor on her last day before maternity leave is thrown into a world of chaos when a hidden threat emerges.

1464795.title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
1464795.overview: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.
1464795.trailerName: Daadi Ki Shaadi Official Trailer | Neetu Kapoor, Kapil Sharma | Ashish R Mohan | In Cinemas 8th May

1475803.title: Governor
1475803.overview: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.
1475803.trailerName: GOVERNOR | Official Trailer | Manoj Bajpayee | Vipul Amrutlal Shah |Chinmay Mandlekar |Aashin A Shah

1480539.title: Fire in the Pond
1480539.overview: A retelling of the events of 9th November 1974 when a group of teenagers saw an unidentified object flying over Salem Mountain.

1484187.title: Al Baraneya
1484187.overview: Pregnant Amal lives together with her family in Al Baraneya, a village outside Cairo, surrounded by jasmine fields. Their chaotic yet loving way of life is upset when a landowner offers to buy their land. The pressure to sell divides the family and doubts begin to grow. When Amal’s cousin Rania visits from Cairo, she captivates Amal and her younger sisters with her modern lifestyle: jeans, TikTok videos, and lively city stories. Amal starts to question the life that seems to have been laid out for her and dreams of moving to Cairo. Now that the potential sale of the land offers the prospect of a future in the city, the family’s unshakable faith in their own life in the village starts to waver.

1503771.title: The Beauty of Errors
1503771.overview: A portrait of a relationship between three generations and how it shifts between the search for closeness, understanding and acceptance, as the teenage son steps closer to adulthood. The film continues to follow the lives of Tero and his son Henri, both previously featured in Kärkkäinen’s documentary The Living Room of a Nation.

1511515.title: Imagine
1511515.overview: Like many teens, Kim, a non binary fifteen year old, is overwhelmed by digital noise, constantly called back to bouts of scrolling by the pings of their phone – until a claw rips through their bedroom and drags them off to a kaleidoscopic otherworld. There, a sardonic alien dog called Jeff sets Kim on a cryptic quest for freedom: to travel to five islands over the course of 24 hours. Guided by Aboriginal Elders and crossing surreal, symbolic realms – a sentient library, a battlefield of ideologies and an ocean of memories – Kim confronts their fears and addictions. From rune-wielding Viking chefs to fascist pirates and a cyborg shaman, each encounter unveils deeper truths about nature, time and spirit.

1527451.title: Wolves
1527451.overview: Luana feels trapped; she is frustrated with society, her family, and her job at a crèche. She searches for stability and a sense of belonging, and finds both in the local black metal scene. While accompanying her cousin's band on tour as their social media manager, she falls in love with the charismatic singer, Wiktor. When his more radical views come to light, causing tension within the band, Luana refuses to see the truth and cannot let him go.

1530395.title: War and Peace
1530395.overview: The love story of young Countess Natasha Rostova and Count Pierre Bezukhov is interwoven with the Great Patriotic War of 1812 against Napoleon's invading army.

1535131.title: Stone Memory
1535131.overview: Urbanization and shifting regimes erased WWII mass graves from Serbian city centers. Brutalist architect Bogdan Bogdanović designed a monumental memorial outside Čačak, both a tribute to the victims and a testament to his architectural vision.  Now largely neglected and overgrown, the memorial is brought to life through the voices of locals, archival materials, and reenactments. The film explores how memory, history, and architecture intersect, gradually revealing the human stories behind the monument’s silence.

1537627.title: Summer Tour
1537627.overview: Few American demographics are more easily caricatured than Deadheads, those swirling, dosing, hippy-dressed vagabonds. But in his infinitely sweet and wise documentary, director Mischa Richter offers us the Deadheads as complex, self-aware and resourceful members of a wandering commune, one that’s admirable for its kindness and care.

1542107.title: Whale Shark Jack
1542107.overview: Sarah, 12, lives on a boat with her parents, who research whale sharks. Her only friend is a whale shark named Jack, who Sarah rescued when he was a pup. But following a tragic accident, mum and Sarah move to the coastal town of Exmouth. Desperate to return to her old life, Sarah pegs all her hopes on Jack, certain that when his migration brings him back to Exmouth, mum will take her out on the boat again. But Jack fails to return, so Sarah embarks on a risky mission to find him.

1550555.title: Petty Thieves
1550555.overview: Rio, an introverted young man, tries to make a living for himself by commiting petty theft in restaurants and resorts around the Croatian coast. His life, however, drastically changes when Andrea, a young Serbian part-time worker, enters his life, with the two becoming partners in crime, planning a major heist of two wealthy women staying at the hotel Andrea works at.

1551451.title: Girl Group
1551451.overview: A pop diva, kicked out of her own group's reunion tour and slapped with a community service court order, seizes the chance to stage a comeback by coaching a group of misfit teen girls for a major record label audition, only to push them too far, forcing her to confront her toxic industry — and her own streak of self-destruction.

1556571.title: The Motel
1556571.overview: A noir crime drama set in 1970's New York

1559067.title: Life is Yours
1559067.overview: In conservative southwestern Germany, four people face a fundamental challenge in their quest to find a path to a happier life. In doing so, everything changes for them. At one point in their lives, they knew with every fiber of their being that things could not continue as they were and that a major change in their lives was necessary. Otherwise, there would be no escape from their emotional chaos and no hope for a happier future. Their names are Gabriel, Elisabeth, Melina, and Dunja. Before, they had different names, different lives, and different genders.

1564251.title: Bushe
1564251.overview: Marta, a lovesick 15 year old, pines for a local boy named Karlo. As the traditional local carnival approaches, its mystical atmosphere and mask making tradition will take her on a personal journey where she will discover the true meaning of her identity.

1568027.title: Checkout: The Movie
1568027.overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

1569947.title: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre
1569947.overview: A family gather to spend Thanksgiving at an isolated cabin, unaware that the site has a horrific history of murder and cannibalism and that the Priest responsible did not rest in peace. Now they are on the menu for Thanksgiving dinner.

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads
Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1570651.title: House Party
1570651.overview: 3 friends arrive at another friend's house to watch a movie, but things quickly go wrong.

1583323.title: The Tallyman
1583323.overview: Up and coming vigilante, the Tallyman, faces his biggest threat yet when he comes across a larger than life figure.

1596315.title: Ghost in the Machine
1596315.overview: The untold origins of artificial intelligence lie not in machines but in power, revealing the fantasies behind the hype that got us here and where we go next.

1597659.title: To Grandfather's Village 2
1597659.overview: Vladik is spending his summer holidays with grandfather Yura again, when Viktor, a former diplomat and Vladik's grandfather by dad, suddenly appears in the village. He quickly finds a common language with the locals, gives his grandson expensive gifts and captivates him with stories about traveling around the world. Rivalry for the grandson's attention breaks out between the grandfathers - from caustic jokes to open confrontation. Grandfather Yura feels more and more that he is losing, but when a dangerous secret from Viktor's past comes to light, he has the opportunity to get rid of a competitor.

1601243.title: Oscar Shaw
1601243.overview: After retiring from the police force, a relentless detective haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend sets out on a perilous quest for vengeance, seeking redemption and fighting to restore justice to the streets he once swore to protect.

1604699.title: The Brave Swing
1604699.overview: These days, Cheng-Cheng seems different. He doesn’t play baseball anymore and stays away from the field. It feels like he has something he can’t tell anyone. His mom tries to help but doesn’t know why. The fear and confusion come from one of the adults he trusts the most. One evening, Cheng-Cheng stands by the field, holding his bat, wondering—should he swing, or not?

1612251.title: Until She Remembers
1612251.overview: When a struggling high school student is confronted with the painful fracture of her family, she seeks refuge far from the noise of her parents’ world. In the company of her grandmother and an old friend, she begins to see life from a distance---both tender and selfless. Her lessons and realizations are things that cannot be learned from books, but only from a life lived.
1612251.trailerName: Until She Remembers | Trailer | Drama w/ Charo Santos-Concio, Barbie Forteza, Boots Anson Roa

1617115.title: Brother Unknown
1617115.overview: With a dark past in the foster system, a lonely woman questions if her new found half-brother is also the violent stalker wracking havoc on her.

1618651.title: I Is Another
1618651.overview: In 1952, a train journey to Oslo becomes a battleground when a journalist and her husband confront a man who claims to have saved thousands during WWII. As questions arise about his true motives, the line between hero and opportunist blurs.

1618843.title: Betty's Revenge
1618843.overview: Three college seniors venture to the abandoned Dizzy Dishes cabaret club while researching its fiery past. They encounter the former owner, Betty — who claims to be half woman, half “something else.”

1628123.title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG
1628123.overview: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.

1628635.title: Secret of Admiral Ushakov
1628635.overview: Russian Empire, 1812. While Napoleon gathers his troops, a French spy infiltrates Admiral Fyodor Ushakov's estate. The great naval commander is ready to rejoin the fray, and his weapons will be his faith and love for his homeland.

1632155.title: Piluk
1632155.overview: Born from a single feather, young Piluk walks on, just as her mother did before her. Throughout her journey, she offers feathers from her thinning wings to passersby and wounded animals. From the raw landscapes of the tundra to a city of concrete, will she still be able to hear the breath of the wind that witnessed her birth?

1633499.title: Diamond Made Man
1633499.overview: Diamond Made Man" spans epochs and galaxies, marking a cinematic milestone as potentially the first Hollywood production to feature an epic confrontation between prehistoric dinosaurs and advanced robotics.Scenes include intense battles in modern city streets where Dr.E.Sreehari, inside a colossal golden robot, clashes with a life-sized T-Rex using groundbreaking practical effects, animatronics, and motion capture technology.The story delves into ancient times around 4700 BC, where humanity's early struggles intertwine with futuristic elements, such as discovering billions in gold aboard a ship in the sea or confronting demonic forces reminiscent of mythological.  ​"A cinematic masterclass in immersion, this film redefines the future of storytelling by seamlessly integrating groundbreaking performance capture, hyper-realistic physics simulations, and native future-proofed VFX ecosystem."

1636891.title: Mexicali
1636891.overview: A former special forces contractor is forced out of retirement as an avocado farmer in Mexico when local gangsters try to force him and his family off their farm.

1638171.title: Suffs
1638171.overview: Created by Tony Award winner Shaina Taub, this musical recorded from Broadway tells the story of the American suffragist movement and the remarkable friendships, heartbreak, and action that brought women together—or, in some cases, tore them apart. The ensemble cast features Taub as Alice Paul, Tony winner Nikki M. James as Ida B. Wells, Tony nominee Jenn Colella as Carrie Chapman Catt, and Grace McLean as President Woodrow Wilson.

1641819.title: Abhhiman
1641819.overview: An emotionally layered drama about memory, legacy, and the cost of love, set against the haunting world of music and cinema.
1641819.trailerName: Abhhiman - Trailer | Prosenjit Chatterjee, Subhashree Ganguly, Jisshu U Sengupta| Indraadip Dasgupta

1648283.title: Overdrive
1648283.overview: A year after his refusal to pull off the track cost his team the championship, an eighteen year old Bahraini karting driver argues his way back into a seat for a twelve hour endurance race, and finds that the only way to win it is the one thing he has never done.

1652827.title: Kinaesthesia
1652827.overview: BAFTA and Grierson award-winning filmmaker Gerald Fox celebrates the centenary of the 'dream film' in cinema and its years of flowering during the silent film period in this kaleidoscopic, stylised documentary.

1667739.title: Разыскивается Дед Мороз
1667739.overview: On New Year's Eve, a not-so-lucky thief, Misha, breaks into a house in the very center of Moscow, where a lonely old man lives. Misha hopes to improve his unenviable financial situation and bring back his family - his wife and seven-year-old daughter. However, in the old man's big house, he finds nothing of any value, except for the deposits of children's toys in the basement. The old man himself assures him that he is none other than the real Father Frost.

1669915.title: Angel and the Badman
1669915.overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

1673179.title: AEW x NJPW x CMLL x Stardom Present Forbidden Door 2026
1673179.overview: The 2026 Forbidden Door was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event and supershow co-produced by the American promotion All Elite Wrestling (AEW), Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and the Japanese promotions New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom (Stardom). It was the fifth annual Forbidden Door event and took place on June 28, 2026 at SAP Center at San Jose in San Jose, California, USA.

1674139.title: threeASFOUR: Full Circle
1674139.overview: Follows avant-garde NYC designers Gabi Asfour, Angela Donhauser, and Adi Gil and their singular "couture-on-the-street" designs; highlighting fashion as a radical act of collaboration shaped by war, identity, and hope.

1675803.title: Sterben für Anfänger
1675803.overview: As renowned science journalist Kurt Langbein is diagnosed with ‘terminal cancer’, a professional topic becomes an existential question: how do we die – and what does it actually mean to die? In his deeply personal documentary film, Langbein embarks on a journey to the boundary between life and death.

1678747.title: The Journal: Starting From Research
1678747.overview: A team of three book writers, try to research the life of one of their friends named Fika for the next 30 days. To get accurate results, they have to stay overnight at Fika's house. Initially the research went smoothly until finally strange things happened and of course Fika's behavior changed. Whether all this happened by chance or there was something behind this event.

1680091.title: Дети наши
1680091.overview: Every year, approximately 48,000 children end up in orphanages. Some find families, others remain in the orphanage until they reach adulthood, and only then set out on their own. But how can you become independent in the adult world without an adult? How do you manage your daily life if you don't know one? How do you find work and save money? And what about finding friends and love? Psychologists, foundation leaders, and the children themselves will discuss the subtle difficulties, stereotypes, and adaptation outside of orphanages. This film is an inside look at the problem of orphanhood in Russia—the perspective of people who are tackling it right now.

1680155.title: Dimension 20: On a Bus
1680155.overview: Dragon Master Katie Marovitch and her people explore the fantastical worlds of LA and Lisbon- but with sentient everyday objects. Using Marovitch's bespoke "Perfect Six" game system, four heroes navigate trials and save a wedding.
1680155.trailerName: D20 on a Bus Season 2 Teaser | New Dimension 20 Season

1684443.title: In the Shadow of the King
1684443.overview: Close confidants, friends and family of Elvis Presley recall never-before-told stories of their life around the King of Rock-N-Roll and his lifelong spiritual quest of balancing his faith and international fame.

1686683.title: Kuzma: Extremely Happy
1686683.overview: Through exclusive archival footage and never before seen home video, this documentary aims to explore the real face of Andriy Viktorovych Kuzmenko (Kuzma Skryabin), the father of the contemporary Ukrainian rock and roll scene.

1686875.title: The Love Heist
1686875.overview: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala.

1688667.title: INDEPENDIENTE
1688667.overview: Three Mexican filmmakers — Max del Río, Gabriela Ivette Sandoval, and Hugo Villaseñor Alcázar — share their processes and challenges around a single question: How can an independent film get seen? Through the eyes of insiders, the documentary reveals the complex journey behind making cinema visible in Mexico.

1689051.title: The Exchange Rate
1689051.overview: After a bank heist, two criminals try to escape the law, sparking a chain of emotional, financial, and romantic fallouts that forces three different stories to collide in unexpected ways.

1691803.title: The Campaign
1691803.overview: The Campaign dives into how this is not just a war of rockets and gunfire, but one of narratives: a global effort to shape public perception around Gaza, Israel, the West, and the Jewish people. It’s a war fought through propaganda, disinformation, and emotional manipulation, amplified by both mainstream and social media.

1698523.title: Love Project
1698523.overview: A hopeless romantic girl struggles to find love in the guys that she meets until she gets a school project and gets paired with another girl in her class, with the goal of uncovering the meaning of love.

1698971.title: The Keris
1698971.overview: A battle over the Keris Tempa Melaka, a legendary blade linked to warrior Hang Tuah, drawing in a Muay Thai practitioner and a Russian mafia syndicate.
1698971.trailerName: The Keris | Official Trailer | Akan Datang Di Pawagam GSC mulai 2 Julai 2026

1699419.title: Acting Like Women
1699419.overview: A documentary that explores the explosive rise of feminist performance art in 1970s Los Angeles, where artists connected to the Woman’s Building challenged sexism and redefined art through bold explorations of body, gender, and identity. Directed by artist and filmmaker Cheri Gaulke, who was part of the movement herself, the documentary combines archival footage and artist interviews to capture the creativity, activism, and community that shaped this groundbreaking era. Executive produced by Lily Tomlin alongside her longtime partner Jane Wagner, the film traces the origins and lasting influence of feminist performance art.

1700187.title: Method Cowboy
1700187.overview: When a struggling actor feigns being gay to land the role of a lifetime in an Oscar-bait Cowboy Western, he decides to transform himself for the role, blurring the lines between reality and performance.

1702107.title: General Admission
1702107.overview: Determined to move on from her cheating ex, a woman joins a support group seeking a fresh start, only to overshare her deepest fears until her healing journey takes an unexpected turn.

1702555.title: Getar Hero
1702555.overview: A down-on-his-luck cowboy roams Bombay's neon night in this lyrical, urban Western.

1702619.title: Billions Club Live with Olivia Rodrigo: A Concert Film
1702619.overview: Live from Barcelona, Olivia Rodrigo takes her top fans on an emotional ride through her biggest songs during a one-night-only Billions Club Live concert. From her Billions Club hits to her new single "drop dead," along with a few fan favorites, it all unravels in one unforgettable live performance.
1702619.trailerName: Olivia Rodrigo’s Billions Club Live Concert Film Trailer | Spotify

1703067.title: Bail
1703067.overview: Bail is an upcoming Kannada action drama film directed by Pavan Wadeyar.
1703067.trailerName: Bail - Official Teaser | Dr. Shiva Rajkumar | Pavan Wadeyar | KVN Productions

1703707.title: Luv Di Saun
1703707.overview: The story follows a young man from Lahore’s inner city who falls in love with a woman facing social restrictions and personal struggles. Their relationship develops amid violence, emotional conflict, and opposition from society. The film explores themes of love, destiny, womanhood, and sacrifice against the cultural backdrop of Old Lahore.

1704987.title: ARE YOU TELLING ME THAT YOU KNOW WHAT TO DO BECAUSE YOU GET NOTES FROM THE FUTURE TELLING YOU SO?
1704987.overview: After finding a note in his locker, a student discovers that he is receiving messages from his future self. As the instructions become increasingly specific, he begins to follow that path that seems to have been laid out for him.

1706011.title: Anak-Anak Bambu
1706011.overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

1706139.title: Saat Aku Bersuara
1706139.overview: Nadia, a bright young lawyer, finds her life shattered when her wedding is canceled at the last second. But that bitterness did not make him submit. She rose up and dedicated herself to defending women's rights. Together with her two friends, Andien and Riana, and Adrian, a Public Prosecutor who is an important part of her journey, Nadia struggles to rebuild her life, including her broken relationship with her father. As the wounds of the past slowly find their way, Nadia becomes increasingly convinced that as long as she dares to speak out and doesn't give up, hope will never be extinguished.

1706715.title: Black Money For White Nights
1706715.overview: After years of saving money from the small bribes they collect, 60-year-old Marina and her husband Gosha from Bulgaria are preparing for their dream trip to St. Petersburg to witness the White Nights. But when Russia invades Ukraine and the travel agency vanishes with all their savings, the couple’s dream collapses along with their illusion of control over their moral principles and the relationship they have with each other.

1707483.title: Don't Save The Date
1707483.overview: Meshi, a barista from Tel Aviv who likes to mess around, has a great habit of avoiding responsibility. He promises his best friend to organize the most luxurious bachelor party ever - and then completely forgets about it. When the day of the party arrives and the obsessive bride hands off the groom to him with very detailed operating instructions, Meshi realizes the severity of the problem he set himself into. With no other choice, he starts planning the event on the go. Soon enough, things get out of control. Between nonstop moments of insanity and some moments of simple truth, Meshi discovers that he might not have been "on it" as he believed.

1707867.title: The Metropolitan Opera 2026/27: Silent Night
1707867.overview: Following his smash-hit company debut with The Hours, composer Kevin Puts returns to the Met with his Pulitzer Prize–winning first opera, inspired by the true events.

1708379.title: The Hot Seat
1708379.overview: World Cup winners from France 1998 and France 2018, plus a crew of comedians, face off in a no-holds-barred comedy roast hosted by Paul de Saint Sernin.

1708571.title: Mirage
1708571.overview: Mirages have been reported along the Spanish coast. A young French woman travels to San Sebastián to observe these visual aberrations. There, she meets a mysterious Portuguese woman who tells her a story from her youth: of obsession, and a gaze that can turn the world inside out.

1709979.title: Let's Make Noise
1709979.overview: When the government tries to take away women’s right to vote, Stella joins forces with Carlotta and Marco to raise awareness. In doing so, she meets Prof. Zanetti, once an inspiring woman, now embittered after a life of lost battles.

1711451.title: A Man Jumps into the Water
1711451.overview: On 10 December 2024, at around two o’clock in the afternoon, a homeless man immerses himself in a lake in a Buenos Aires park and disappears. From this news item, the filmmaker reflects on the films that will never be made and those that may still be possible.

1712475.title: Runner
1712475.overview: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time

1715227.title: Burnt Ends
1715227.overview: Ten filmmakers were tasked with making surreal short film segments that loosely involve a cigarette. The result is Lynchian chaos in anthology form - the good ends, the bad ends, the loose ends, and the burnt ends. A sprawling anthology about all things cigarettes.

1715291.title: Hidden Secrets: The Movie
1715291.overview: Before the masks became a burden, two heroes fought to save a city-and a sister-from a darkness that was only just beginning to stir.

1718299.title: Samarpit Father’s Love
1718299.overview: Samarpit Father's Love is an emotional story of Ashok, a simple farmer whose life changes forever after losing his wife during the birth of their son, Harsh.After tragedy strikes again when his crops are destroyed in a fire, Ashok sacrifices everything to raise and educate his son.Through hunger, struggle, and endless hardships, he dedicates his entire life to giving Harsh a better future. But when old age arrives and Ashok needs his son the most, life takes an unexpected emotional turn.A heart-touching tale of every father who silently sacrifices his dreams and happiness for his children.
1718299.trailerName: Dedicated: Father's Love Trailer | Annkit Yadavv and Jaya Bhattacharya

1719259.title: Remember When...
1719259.overview: Two estranged friends, meeting for the first time in years, start to journey through their memories. As they travel along, strange details begin creeping up, forcing them to come to terms with a personal tragedy.

1721499.title: Session 14
1721499.overview: A man denying his grief seeks redemption through a therapist, but when he must relive what he caused will he take responsibility?

1722331.title: The Award Ceremony of the 31st Shanghai TV Festival Magnolia Blossom
1722331.overview: The 31st Shanghai Television Festival "Magnolia Awards" Ceremony  took place on June 26, 2026, at the Lingang Center in Shanghai. As one of the most prestigious and authoritative television honors in Asia, the Magnolia Awards celebrate exceptional achievements in TV broadcasting, acting, directing, and screenwriting.The 2026 edition evaluated outstanding Chinese dramas, variety shows, and international programs. The jury panel was highly globalized, featuring 15 industry professionals from seven countries, including Ireland, Germany, France, Malaysia, Singapore, Italy, and China.

1723995.title: Fantasia
1723995.overview: In a mysterious music venue, Luan makes a living performing erotic shows for mysterious men. When a sinister client appears, he discovers the fine line between dreams and nightmares.

1724251.title: The Wind, One Brilliant Day
1724251.overview: “The wind, one brilliant day, called to my soul with an odor of jasmine.” Last autumn, actress Tang Wei softly recited these lines in English while sitting beside director Ben Rivers on a fallen tree trunk in the outskirts of London. Together, they carefully searched for the poem's rhythm, as the wind rustled through the trees.

1724315.title: Exchange
1724315.overview: A paralysed teenage boy, isolated on a private hospital ward. His life flashes before, last moments of life, with a vivid encounter with death. Is the accounted recollection forged or an authentic perspective ?

1727259.title: La Hère
1727259.overview: When a rookie forest ranger flees into the Quebec wilderness to escape a brutal hazing ritual, he finds himself hunted not only by his peers, but by a towering creature of folklore stalking him through the woods.

1727323.title: Goodbye, Ane!
1727323.overview: Ane is a young Lithuanian woman and wife of a fisherman who left for sea. Her husband's wait grows longer and longer until she becomes confused between what is real and what is illusion in an increasingly confused and dreamlike wait until evening falls.

1733275.title: Myosotis
1733275.overview: When a nursing home resident tries to embark on her dream trip, the constant disappearances of her suitcase force her into a frantic battle with her own mind.

1736475.title: Boatbuilders
1736475.overview: Over the course of 16 months, at the head of a remote harbor in Maine, the workers of the Brooklin Boat Yard meticulously build a 56-foot wooden sailboat. As the seasons change and the vessel takes shape, director Luke Lorentzen immerses the viewer in a close-knit community rooted in time-honored craft, shared joys, and mutual respect.

1736731.title: Muguruza FM 40 Tour
1736731.overview: Four decades after taking to the stage for the first time, Fermín Muguruza launches into his last major tour: a collective journey to celebrate 40 years of music, engagement and cultural resistance. This music documentary captures the pulse of that voyage: concerts packed to the hilt, endless kilometres on the road, all sorts of encounters on the way and a shared energy that stretches beyond generations, from the bands Kortatu and Negu Gorriak to his current solo career.​
1736731.trailerName: DOC'N ROLL FF 2026: MUGURUZA FM 40 Tour Trailer

1736795.title: Deep Sleep
1736795.overview: A young man suffering from sleep paralysis begins to fear that the figure haunting his bedroom is more than just a nightmare.

1738843.title: K-Pop Shark Heroes
1738843.overview: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

1739547.title: Overlooked
1739547.overview: Overlooked follows Matt Iman as he returns home from a two-year LDS mission and begins navigating adulthood while living with Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH), a rare genetic condition that leaves his body unable to produce cortisol. Though he appears healthy, every day is shaped by medication, emergency preparedness, and the constant risk of a life threatening adrenal crisis. Through intimate observational storytelling, the film offers a deeply personal look at life with an invisible illness while exploring resilience, family, and the invisible realities of living with a rare disease.

1740251.title: Rapunzel
1740251.overview: Caíque is bullied because of his long hair, considered girlish by the boys in his neighborhood. Torn between fitting in and being true to himself, he feels compelled to take a radical step.

1740763.title: Bismillah
1740763.overview: Haunted by his failure at his Bismillah as a 4 year old, Azhar (Adolyn H. Dar) seeks redemption by re-doing the ceremony - 30 years later as an adult.

1742299.title: The MAD World of Harvey Kurtzman
1742299.overview: Bursting from the immigrant streets of 1920s Brooklyn, Harvey Kurtzman ignited a creative revolution reshaping comics, satire, and popular culture. Through rare archives, unseen interviews, handcrafted animation, and an original jazz score, this documentary reveals the man who created MAD Magazine and helped redefine American humour and visual storytelling forever.

1743067.title: The Plage
1743067.overview: Brankec just wants to escape the horros of civilisation and enjoy his time at the beach. However, his retreat turns out to be anything but quiet.

1743707.title: Like a Mammoth to a Giant Flame
1743707.overview: LIke a Mammoth to a Giant Flame is a 45 minute documentary/concert film about the Montreal band Mellow Casualty.

1744667.title: Only Bears
1744667.overview: Over the course of one wildly unpredictable day, two married bears attempt to rekindle their intimacy—but between traffic, screenings, queer social chaos, and a stranger handing them gently used pizza, life keeps acting like the pushy “third” in their relationship

1744859.title: Palace Detroit 313
1744859.overview: A skate video by Palace, filmed in Detroit over a seven-year period (2018–2025).

1746651.title: The Copycat Killer

1748891.title: Lero Lero 1:1 | Ten Years of Experiencing Spaces
1748891.overview: Lero Lero, a student organization formed in 2015 at the School of Architecture and Urbanism and Design of USP, showcases a decade of work based in the idea that education extends beyond the classroom, seeking to connect students with architecture, urban planning, design and art projects at their actual scale.
1748891.trailerName: "Lero Lero 1:1 | Dez anos vivenciando espaços" - Trailer | Documentário

1749531.title: Nelly Rapp – The Gateway to the Underworld

1749787.overview: Two men meet one night to engage in a radical and mysterious act of intimacy.

The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

1751323.title: Bad Parenting
1751323.overview: Two young brothers are left alone in a car while their dad paddleboards out at sea. When a mischievous local boy climbs into the backseat, an ordinary beach day takes a dangerous turn.

1751387.title: ISO: Whore in Law
1751387.overview: Two sisters turn the grief over their dying brother into an absurd mission to expose their unfaithful sister-in-law.
1751387.trailerName: Mira el tráiler de 'Se busca cuñada', un cortometraje dirigido por Lore V. Olivera - Exclusiva THR

1752027.title: First Five
1752027.overview: An unprecedented, intimate look at the five young men who served as Coach Bob Knight's very first recruiting class for the Indiana University basketball team from 1971 to 1975.

1752155.title: Jollyface
1752155.overview: The  movie follows a woman investigating a murder while being hunted in her apartment building.

1752411.title: Almost Afraid
1752411.overview: Simon Britton, documentarian and skeptic, visits Brisbane's most haunted house to investigate reports of paranormal activity.
1752411.trailerName: Almost Afraid | with Simon Britton | Archival Trailer (1999)

1753435.title: Danse Macabre
1753435.overview: Two mates arrive at a silent disco party in the suburbs, soon finding sinister forces taking over their estranged friend.

1755291.title: NAZA
1755291.overview: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

1756059.title: The Times of Kollywood
1756059.overview: The Times of Kollywood is a coming-of-age comedy-drama and a love letter to Tamil cinema. The story follows 17-year-old Madhavan Gurusamy, an aspiring filmmaker and passionate Kollywood cinephile, who desperately wants his disciplined classmate Bala Murugan to experience the excitement of a first-day-first-show (FDFS) celebration for Vikram. When Madhavan promises Bala’s strict family that they can trust his choice of film, an innocent mistake involving a wrongly downloaded file leads to an embarrassing disaster. Determined to make things right, Madhavan earns back their trust and eventually brings Bala to the theatre. Through friendship, humour and youthful mistakes, the film celebrates the emotional connection between audiences and cinema, reminding us that Kollywood is more than stars, songs and mass moments. It is about memories, relationships and the people who make cinema meaningful.

1757723.overview: Samhain in ancient Ireland, a young boy makes his first mask to hide from wandering spirits, but his family’s supper is interrupted by a visitor from the Otherworld.

1768475.overview: On the last Christmas dinner with her friends, Laia tries to make everything go perfectly. But when she discovers that time has frozen, everything she was trying to keep under control is suspended, forcing her to confront her greatest fear.

1770715.title: Forqué. El oficio de hacer cine
1770715.overview: Actors and filmmakers revisit the career of José María Forqué, a director whose name is familiar through the awards that honour him but whose work is less widely known. His own voice joins their recollections in a portrait of his approach to filmmaking and his place in Spanish popular cinema.

1773275.title: Noelle Nomads
1773275.overview: Before they can embark on their luxurious Hawaiian holiday, uptight sports medicine physician Joseph and his daughter Annie must first begrudgingly make a pit stop at a remote campground and deliver a package from his late father to a mysterious person named Birdie. Their plans are derailed when Joseph accidentally crashes into free-spirited Nora's RV at a rest stop. Things go from bad to worse when they not only fail to find the elusive Birdie, but their ancient Winnebago breaks down as well. Forced to spend the next few days at the campground while they wait for replacement parts, Nora introduces Joseph and Annie to the eccentric campers who lovingly dub themselves the Nomads. The embers of romance begin to glow as Nora shows Joseph how to embrace the freedom of camp life. When the mystery of who Birdie is becomes clearer and the much-awaited parts arrive, allowing Joseph and Annie to finally make their Hawaiian getaway,
